text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we’re doing a staggered cutover for SDK v1.4 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need to lock owners and dependencies now: docs/changelog cutoff, sampleapps smoke, and eng-platform CI image bump.
aj: I’ll own the SDK rollout (canary -> 30% -> 100%). I can do the rollout script and monitor metrics.
leo: I can own the docs freeze + changelog finalization. Plan to cut changelog at 08:00 PT and merge any urgent doc fixes by 07:30.
olivia: For sampleapps: a few outstanding PRs depend on the new CI image. @ben — can you confirm image tag promotion time? Also need someone to run the quickstarts smoke on latest images.
ben: Yep — we’ll promote the image by 06:30 PT. Tag will be redwood/ci:stable-20250409. I’ll post the promotion event here once it’s live.
ben: Promotion command we use:
```bash
docker tag staging:latest redwood/ci:stable-20250409
docker push redwood/ci:stable-20250409
```
sam: I can coordinate the sampleapps smoke matrix. Will run on macOS/linux and node/python quickstarts, report back by 07:45 PT. Need list of sampleapps that must pass (suggest: quickstart-js, quickstart-py, sampleapp-chat).
olivia: sampleapp-graph has failing e2e on the staging image — pushing a fix now but would be great if CI image promotion is timed so the fix lands before smoke.
pr-reviewer: I’ll do last-pass reviews for sampleapps after 05:00 PT. Ping me when PRs are green.
docs-qa-bot: docs lint noticed 3 warnings in quickstart v2: missing codeblock language, broken internal link /guides/auth. See https://ci/docs-lint/3421
ci-bot: image promotion job finished: redwood/ci:stable-20250409 is live (06:31 PT).
aj: thanks @ben and @ci-bot — I’ll start canary at 09:00 PT against dedicated infra, 15-minute observation windows. If latency/cost within targets, push to 30% at ~09:30.
leo: changelog cut at 08:00 PT — I’ll assemble PR with entries and tag contributors. If you have a last-minute doc change, drop it into the "docs-hotfix" branch and ping me.
maya: Owners recap: rollout = aj, docs/changelog = leo, sampleapps smoke = sam, CI image = ben, PR reviews = pr-reviewer. Oliva, you lead sampleapp fixes. Does everyone accept? :thumbsup:
aj: accept :thumbsup:
leo: accept :thumbsup:
olivia: accept — will watch graph PRs.
ben: accept — will monitor registry.
sam: accept — making smoke checklist now.
pr-reviewer: accept — will be on-call for reviews.
maya: Great. Action items: 1) ben posts image event (done). 2) those with PRs = merge by 07:30. 3) sam runs smoke and posts matrix by 07:45. 4) leo merges changelog by 08:00. 5) aj begins canary at 09:00. If blockers, reply here and we’ll escalate to eng-platform/infra.
maya: Final note — if any tooling/CI flakes, tag #eng-infra and @ben. I’ll update the status board after canary start. Thanks all. :rocket:
